Expose timestamped PressGate sampling over native double recognition, long output, pulse and turbo logic. Coordinate same-condition short, long and double recognition before ordinary outputs, with exact deadlines and release catch-up. Retain the double-press state 3 fix so a recognized second press stays held. Add OutputHoldBack, a timestamped single-output adapter calling the unchanged native remapper_hold_back::hold_back_tick for deferred output and replay; Studio supplies unordered chord deadlines and full-release claims.

files.notes: Extract the original JSM quadratic Flick easing. Map normalized strengths 0–1 to linear at 0, JSM quadratic at 0.5 and cubic ease-out at 1 for RWS and its preview. Blend linear/quadratic below 0.5 and use power ease-out above 0.5. Expose the shared strength limit. Extract the original JSM angle-dependent duration multiplier as flick_time_scale.

files.patch: Expose StickRebound and the existing trigger range function to the headless adapter. The upstream algorithms are unchanged.

files.notes: Headless gyro sample timing with the original per-sample math and filter order. Both Flick sites now call the shared original easing expression in eval/curves.rs. Reuse flick_time_scale at both existing time-exponent call sites without changing JSM timing behavior.
Add a trigger-only headless entry point that calls the original analog state machine. Extract the unchanged NoMouse overlapping direction predicate for both native JSM and Studio callers.
Pass the host's per-sample interval to aiming and cache immutable Studio programs per node.
Expose source naming, the existing curves, headless gyro timing, trigger-only entry point and shared NoMouse stick direction predicate.
Compile JSM Config and expose its parser, trigger-only entry point and shared NoMouse direction predicate in the headless evaluator.

Add optional flick_release_ease (default 0 for upstream callers, range 0–1) for the initial Flick. Strength 0.5 reproduces JSM quadratic easing. Preserve total angle and duration with two cumulative-progress state slots. Optional flick_input_dt lets Studio observe FIFO gestures between output ticks; the default keeps the original single-clock behavior. Optional flick_release_ratio exposes the tracking threshold in the native state machine while preserving the original default for callers that omit it. Optional flick_disengage_ms exposes the sustained release hold (0–60 ms). Callers that omit it keep 60 ms. Optional flick_time_exponent (0–2, default 0) scales initial release duration relative to 180 degrees using the shared JSM helper; tracking/catch-up timing is unchanged. Immediate retriggers discard stale initial payout.
Register the original JSM node in the headless registry.
Retain native JSM node state and consume the next sample timing.
